{"sourceType":"ESA Tender Action","sourceSystem":"ESA esa-star Publication","sourcePage":"https://esastar-publication-ext.sso.esa.int/ESATenderActions/filter/open","id":164808,"idEra":23940,"activityNumber":"1000044301","contractNumber":"","tanumber":"1-13017","title":"INVESTIGATION OF GAS-SURFACE INTERACTIONS ON RE-USABLE UPPER STAGE LAUNCHERS - EXPRO+","description":"Objectives: To develop affordable, re-usable aerodynamic shapes involving the re-entry of upper stages of launchers. Description: The use of ceramics and metallic materials on aerodynamic shapes for reusable systems technology allows for affordable and sustainable operations involving the re-entry of upper stages of launchers. This study aims at designing and prototyping the shapes with an appropriate material combination that can survive the mechanical stresses induced in the initial ascent and can subsequently survive the extreme heating and mechanically shear environment of re-entry.
